_comment: The seven Common Actions from rulebook 6.1 (book p.91). Every Mech has these in addition to the Actions printed on its Parts, so a squad's real options are its Part Actions plus whichever of these its surviving Parts can initiate. They are not in cards.json because they are not printed on any card, so they are transcribed here by hand. The printed rulebook always wins over this file.
_shape: Each entry mirrors a CardAction closely enough to be merged into the guided action list: id, name, type (the Action Type, matching the card data's spelling), size (s = Short = 1 Action Tick, m = Medium = 2 Action Ticks), and the Part slots that can initiate it. `phase` marks the three that resolve in the End Phase rather than during an Action Opportunity.
_source: rules/06_missions_and_appendix.md section 6.1, transcribed from book p.91

actions.requires: a Part whose Action carries the Charge icon

description.en:
· Silence: this does not remove Optical Camouflage or Low Profile.
· Charge an Action that carries the Charge icon. That Action becomes Charged and takes a face-up Charge Token, to be consumed later.

actions.requires: a Part with the Handheld entry

description.en:
· Silence: this does not remove Optical Camouflage or Low Profile.
· Switch one or more Handheld Parts to the Discard State.

· Melee Attack at base contact, rolling 2 red melee dice.
· Because every Mech has this, almost every Mech can create a Melee Lock.

· Shove a target 1 Grid.
· This cannot be used to Break Away.

· End Phase action.
· Become Revealed and perform Manifestation Movement.

· End Phase action. Silence.
· Remove 1 Square Token or 1 Hexagon Token from this Unit, then Restore 1 Link.

· End Phase action.
· Target an enemy in the Optical Camouflage State or bearing a Low Profile Token, then make an Electronic-counter Roll.
· On a success, a camouflaged target is Revealed and a Low Profile Token is removed.
